Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 select_count number := 0 ;
 current_text_item varchar2(80) ;
 current_list_item varchar2(80) ;
 current_desc_item varchar2(80) ;
 cur_item_type varchar2(20) ;
 x_pos number ;
 y_pos number ;

 list_counter number := 1 ;
 cur_list_code varchar2(5) ;
 cur_list_desc varchar2(50) ;
begin
 /*-- Set the current_item variable based on the value of current_selection.
 current_selection is set based on the click of any list button ---*/
 if :current_list = 'JOB' then
 current_text_item := 'CONTROL_BLOCK.S_JOB_CODE' ;
 current_list_item := 'CONTROL_BLOCK.S_JOB_CODE_LIST' ;
 current_desc_item := 'CONTROL_BLOCK.JOB_DESC' ;
 x_pos := :job_x_pos ;
 y_pos := :job_y_pos ;
 elsif :current_list = 'DRIVER' then
 current_text_item := 'CONTROL_BLOCK.S_DRIVER_CODE' ;
 current_list_item := 'CONTROL_BLOCK.S_DRIVER_CODE_LIST' ;
 current_desc_item := 'CONTROL_BLOCK.DRIVER_DESC' ;
 x_pos := :driver_x_pos ;
 y_pos := :driver_y_pos ;
 elsif :current_list = 'TEAM' then
 current_text_item := 'CONTROL_BLOCK.S_TEAM_ID' ;
 current_list_item := 'CONTROL_BLOCK.S_TEAM_ID_LIST' ;
 current_desc_item := 'CONTROL_BLOCK.TEAM_DESC' ;
 x_pos := :team_x_pos ;
 y_pos := :team_y_pos ;
 elsif :current_list = 'ATTRIB' then
 current_text_item := 'CONTROL_BLOCK.S_ATTR_CODE' ;
 current_list_item := 'CONTROL_BLOCK.S_ATTR_CODE_LIST' ;
 current_desc_item := 'CONTROL_BLOCK.ATTR_DESC' ;
 x_pos := :attr_x_pos ;
 y_pos := :attr_y_pos ;
 elsif :current_list = 'FACILITY' then
 current_text_item := 'CONTROL_BLOCK.S_FACILITY_CODE' ;
 current_list_item := 'CONTROL_BLOCK.S_FACILITY_CODE_LIST' ;
 current_desc_item := 'CONTROL_BLOCK.FACILITY_DESC' ;
 x_pos := :facility_x_pos ;
 y_pos := :facility_y_pos ;
 end if ;
 go_block('LIST_BLOCK') ;
 first_record ;
 loop
 if :sel_flag = 'Y' and :list_block.list_code is not null then
 select_count := select_count + 1 ;
 cur_list_code := :list_code ;
 cur_list_desc := :list_desc ;
 end if ;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit ;
 else
 next_record ;
 end if ;
 end loop ;

 if get_item_property(current_text_item,DISPLAYED) = 'TRUE' then
 cur_item_type := 'TEXT' ;
 else
 cur_item_type := 'LIST' ;
 end if ;

 if select_count = 0 then /*-- No items are selected --*/
 if cur_item_type = 'LIST' then /*-- Hide list item, show text item --*/
 set_item_property(current_list_item,DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 do_item_display(current_text_item) ;
 end if ;
 copy(null,current_text_item) ;
 copy(null,current_desc_item) ;
 elsif select_count = 1 then /*-- Text item will be displayed --*/
 if cur_item_type = 'LIST' then /*-- Hide list item, show text item --*/
 set_item_property(current_list_item,DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 do_item_display(current_text_item) ;
 end if ;
 copy(cur_list_code,current_text_item) ;
 copy(cur_list_desc,current_desc_item) ;
 elsif select_count > 1 then /*-- List item will be displayed --*/
 if cur_item_type = 'TEXT' then /*-- Hide text item, show list item --*/
 set_item_property(current_text_item,DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 do_item_display(current_list_item) ;
 set_item_property(current_list_item,POSITION,x_pos,y_pos) ;
 clear_list(current_list_item) ;

 /*-- Repopulate the list --*/
 go_block('LIST_BLOCK');
 first_record ;
 loop
 if :sel_flag = 'Y' then
 add_list_element(current_list_item,list_counter,:list_desc,:list_code) ;
 list_counter := list_counter + 1 ;
 end if ;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit ;
 else
 next_record ;
 end if ;
 end loop ;
 add_list_element(current_list_item,list_counter,'MULTIPLE SELECTION','MS') ;
 /*-- Assign 'Multiple Selections' to list item --*/
 copy('MS',current_list_item) ;
 end if ;
 end if ; 
 -- go_block('CONTROL_BLOCK') ;


 /*---- Navigate to the correct item ---*/
 if :current_list = 'JOB' then
 if select_count > 1 then
 go_item('S_JOB_CODE_LIST') ;
 else
 go_item('S_JOB_CODE') ;
 end if ;
 elsif :current_list = 'DRIVER' then
 if select_count > 1 then
 go_item('S_DRIVER_CODE_LIST') ;
 else
 go_item('S_DRIVER_CODE') ;
 end if ;
 elsif :current_list = 'TEAM' then
 if select_count > 1 then
 go_item('S_TEAM_ID_LIST') ;
 else
 go_item('S_TEAM_ID') ;
 end if ;
 elsif :current_list = 'ATTRIB' then
 if select_count > 1 then
 go_item('S_ATTR_CODE_LIST') ;
 else
 go_item('S_ATTR_CODE') ;
 end if ;
 elsif :current_list = 'FACILITY' then
 if select_count > 1 then
 go_item('S_FACILITY_CODE_LIST') ;
 else
 go_item('S_FACILITY_CODE') ;
 end if ;
 end if ;

 hide_window('LIST_WINDOW') ;
end ;

PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
v_local_time date;
v_sysdate varchar2(20);
BEGIN
 --:global.program_version := '1.01.02';
 --:global.program_version := '2.03.00';
 --:global.program_version := '3.01.00';
 --:global.program_version := '02';
 --:global.program_version := '03'; -- IM 2236
 --:global.program_version := '04'; -- IM # 4686 -- Added chapter_id to valid_skills query
 --:global.program_version := '05'; -- sysdate conversion
 --:global.program_version := '06'; -- IM 8497
 --:global.program_version := '07'; -- duplicate objects removal from GRP_LAF_STND
 
 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 --:global.program_version := '01';
 :GLOBAL.program_version := '02'; -- IM 501 (timezone changes made to this screen)
 
 execute_trigger('util_banner');

 disable_toolbar_initial ;

/*-- The X and Y positions are stored in advance because afterwards when you are in
 another window (LIST_WINDOW), then GET_ITEM_PROPERTY for X_POS and Y_POS giving
 problem. ----*/

 :job_y_pos := to_number(get_item_property('S_JOB_CODE',Y_POS)) ;
 :driver_x_pos := to_number(get_item_property('S_DRIVER_CODE',X_POS)) ;
 :driver_y_pos := to_number(get_item_property('S_DRIVER_CODE',Y_POS)) ;
 :team_x_pos := to_number(get_item_property('S_TEAM_ID',X_POS)) ;
 :team_y_pos := to_number(get_item_property('S_TEAM_ID',Y_POS)) ;

 :facility_y_pos := to_number(get_item_property('S_FACILITY_CODE',Y_POS)) ;
 :SORT_ORDER := 'A';
 
 /* 
 -- time zone change --04/15/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 :global.v_sysdate := to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 :global.v_sysdate := to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;
 */
 
 BEGIN
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 :CONTROL_BLOCK.chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 :CONTROL_BLOCK.chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF; 
 END; 


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_LIST_PROCESSING
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_list_processing IS
 CURSOR mcodes_cur(p_codeType VARCHAR2, p_code VARCHAR2) IS
 SELECT code, description
 FROM valid_master_codes
 WHERE code_type = p_codeType
 AND code = NVL(p_code, code)
 AND :CONTROL_BLOCK.CHP_SYSDATE 
 BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, :CONTROL_BLOCK.CHP_SYSDATE +1);
 
 CURSOR job_cur IS
 SELECT code, description
 FROM valid_master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'JOBTY'
 AND code != 'MEMBR'
 AND :CONTROL_BLOCK.CHP_SYSDATE 
 BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, :CONTROL_BLOCK.CHP_SYSDATE +1);
BEGIN
 go_block('LIST_BLOCK');
 clear_block;
 first_record;
 if :current_list = 'JOB' then
 set_window_property('LIST_WINDOW', TITLE, 'Select Job');
 for jobrec in job_cur loop
 :list_block.list_code := jobrec.code;
 :list_block.list_desc := jobrec.description;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 elsif :current_list = 'DRIVER' then
 set_window_property('LIST_WINDOW', TITLE, 'Select Driver');
 :list_block.list_code := 'VDRVR';
 :list_block.list_desc := 'Van';
 next_record;
 :list_block.list_code := 'CDRVR';
 :list_block.list_desc := 'Coach';
 next_record;
 elsif :current_list = 'TEAM' then
 set_window_property('LIST_WINDOW', TITLE, 'Select Team');
 for teamrec in mcodes_cur('TEAMS', NULL) loop
 :list_block.list_code := teamrec.code;
 :list_block.list_desc := teamrec.description;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 elsif :current_list = 'ATTRIB' then
 set_window_property('LIST_WINDOW', TITLE, 'Select Attribute');
 for attr_rec in mcodes_cur('SATTR', NULL) loop
 :list_block.list_code := attr_rec.code;
 :list_block.list_desc := attr_rec.description;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 elsif :current_list = 'FACILITY' then
 set_window_property('LIST_WINDOW', TITLE, 'Select Facility');
 for faclt_rec in mcodes_cur('FACLT', NULL) loop
 :list_block.list_code := faclt_rec.code;
 :list_block.list_desc := faclt_rec.description;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_record != '1' then
 delete_record;
 first_record;
 end if;
end;

 v_date1 date;
begin

ProgramUnit.Name: PREPARE_IN_STRING
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE PREPARE_IN_STRING (cur_list_item in varchar2,in_string out varchar2) IS
 list_count number ;
 cur_value varchar2(10) ;
BEGIN
 list_count := get_list_element_count(cur_list_item) ;

 for i in 1..list_count loop
 cur_value := get_list_element_value(cur_list_item,i) ;
 if cur_value is not null and cur_value != 'MS' then
 if NVL(length(in_string), 0) > 0 then
 in_string := in_string||','||''''||cur_value||'''' ;
 else
 in_string := ''''||cur_value||'''' ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
 end loop ;
 in_string := '('||in_string||')' ;
END;
